description: Read-only PKDNS resolution of Jeb's own identity, captured so the compiled production homeserver pin has in-repo provenance instead of a public key copied out of another checkout.
command: node --input-type=module -e 'import { Pubky, PublicKey } from "@synonymdev/pubky"; const p = new Pubky(); const hs = await p.getHomeserverOf(PublicKey.from("9o6xrx8wgqu48dmb47uep6w3dgbwdnf5jgw83gbeuxg9yi7x444y")); console.log(hs.z32());'
